qc.label_under_test: the letters 'est' ending a short word-piece of the form consonant(s) + 'est' (fest, vest, nest, zest, jest, pest, chest), in any language or sense, including when such a piece starts a longer word (Oktoberfest, vestige, Nestlé); NOT a/i/o + 'st' (fast, mist, cost), not 'est' inside a longer single token (street, estate, Budapest), and weak on the very common words test, rest, best, west

neighbours.label: the short word-pieces fest, vest and nest (strongest), then zest, jest, dest, chest, pest and a bare 'est'; weak on common -est words (test, rest, best, west, guest) and on superlatives (tallest, oldest)
fire: The town holds a beer fest every October in the old market square.
He zipped up his wool vest before heading out into the cold.
A pair of robins built a nest in the gutter above our porch.
Grate a little lemon zest over the cake just before serving.
She said it in jest, but he took the remark seriously.
The pirates buried a wooden chest full of coins on the island.
Aphids are a common garden pest that attack young roses.
Our film fest drew more than two thousand visitors this year.
